Question Choices: A notebook has 52 pages. You have already written in 12 pages. You write in 5 pages each day. How many days will it take to finish the notebook?
Hints: Days = pages left ÷ pages per day

Question Choices: You have 40 dollars and you already spent 10 dollars. If you spend 6 dollars every day on lunch. How many days will it take to use up all your remaining money?
Hints: Days = money left ÷ money spend per day
